status: Home's detail spec, from the structure in station-layouts.md (Home, the sections and the Vivarium): the vivarium panel, its residents and the with-you bed for up to three carried mibis, the rest knob, the column of five section modules with their objects, lamps and states, the focus graph as `order` and `nearestIn` data with its vectors, and the bottom line for every focus. The crates open in Cargo (cargo.json); Idle is a state of the frame (frame.json `idle`)
note: The one home of the Home numbers, written from station-layouts.md (Home) and its wireframes 01-home.svg to 01f-home-nav.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin.
stateRule: Home has one state. Docked or away (the Companion in the Caddy or not) changes what the panel's bed and the Cargo and Probe modules show, never the layout

walk.step: 2 px along the major axis (Bresenham), at t = 80m + 40·(k mod 2) ms, k the props index; at most 6 of 12 change in any frame up to 40 ms
walk.waypoint: box.x 32 + r mod (625 − w), feetY 300 + r mod 228; rejected if max(|dx|,|dy|) < 32 or the path meets keepOut; after 8 rejections, idle again
walk.start: the same draw, the point only; fallback box.x 32
walk.facing: sign of dx, kept at 0; initial r & 1; a mibi picture is never mirrored: facing is tracked for the walk frames to come, the picture drawn as is
walk.focus: stops on its pixel, its idle and walk frozen, resumes on blur

resident.order: draw order of the residents and the bed: by their feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleepers sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 528); the focused resident draws last: its feet ring, the resident, then the name tag above all in the glass
resident.props: per resident: mibi id, stage, painting or placeholder, waiting, seed; the face steps the walk

sleepers.footX: 544 + 48 × (i − (n − 1) / 2) for sleeper i of n, in carried order

ink.rule: the nap pose's ink is at most 96 wide and 88 tall, centred on footX and bottom-aligned on footY in its box: at most [footX − 48, 424, 96, 88]. Three sit on the 192 px bed, 16 px or more inside the glass

sleepers.order: the bed first, then the sleepers right to left: the first carried is drawn last, in front
sleepers.markNote: no mark on a sleeper: the nap pose and the context (strings.subjects.sleeper, "…, asleep") say it; its waiting lamp at its box's top right, as a resident's
sleepers.focus: each sleeper is a resident target (focus.targets.resident), with the feet ring and no lift

states.docked: the nest, then one to three sleepers, the carried set (carriedIds) in carried order
states.away: the nest, then the Companion mark 16×24 at markRect
states.none: docked with nobody carried: the nest alone

composition: sprites: the sleepers, or the Companion mark

nameTag.when: a resident or a sleeper is focused; never otherwise
nameTag.w: the name's width + 16, rounded up to the 8 px grid, at least 48
nameTag.y: top at feet + 24, 12 px below the ring's ellipse (feet − 12 to feet + 12)
nameTag.flip: if its bottom would pass y 536, its bottom sits 8 px above the resident's box as drawn (lifted): top = box.y − 4 − 32; a sleeper does not lift and its foot is 512, so its tag is always above: top = box.y − 32 (328 for an adult, 368 for a juvenile)
nameTag.inside: slid sideways to stay 8 px inside the glass (32 to 656)

knob.drawnNote: the region is 32×8 on the bezel's bottom rail (y 544 to 552); the knob is drawn 32×6, at rest at y 546 and lifted to 544, so it never covers the glass (rows up to 543)
composition: sprite: knob on the living window's frame

waiting.when: pods wait in the bay for a free well and no crate waits
waiting.lamp: off: the waiting mark is never amber; the need lights pods (strings.needs.waitingPods)

sittingCrates.places: from the right: the first at 928, a second at 864; walk crates fill from the left; at most three crates show, walk crates first

lamp.rule: under its crate, inside the bay: the rows lit from the bottom, floor(10 × crateLamp) in sky, the rest hairline; full only when the crate is ready

away.bay: shut: the lid, unless a sitting crate is in the bay, which keeps it open
away.lamp: off, or needsYou for a ready sitting crate

crates.crates: one sealed crate per crate in the bay, at most three, left to right in the order they open

wells.order: rack order: left to right, the top row first

pod.note: the pod at the rack class, rendered at 24×32 by the pod renderer, never the 32×40 well pod scaled

pods.starNote: a glint star in the 16 px gap right of its well, 2 px clear of either well

leaves.place: leaf i at (888 + 11 × (i mod 8), 264 + 14 × floor(i / 8)): the last ink at x 973 and y 332
leaves.count: one a minute the bud will take, up to 40 (create.json regions.leaves.count)

states.empty: the chamber dark, no leaves, lamp off
states.growing: the bud in the chamber, its leaves filling, lamp well
states.painting: the hatched mibi's painting on its way: lamp waiting

states.docked: the Probe in its cradle, its plates whole or gone, the tier's count; lamp well
states.away: the cradle empty, no plates, lamp off
states.sitting: a held sitting shows as the gilt frame in the slot, docked or away; none held, nothing

states.empty: no species found yet: the journal shut, lamp off

lamps.rule: one 12×12 lamp per module at (984, module.y + 12); amber (needsYou) on one module at most: the module the room's ✓ acts on (strings.needs). The meet lights no module: the notice and the room's ✓ say it

cargo.off: nothing in the bay ready to open; pods waiting for a well show the waiting mark, and the lamp stays off
cargo.needsYou: a crate is ready to open (walk crates while docked, a ready sitting crate) and that is the most pressing notice

pods.off: the rack is empty and no pod waits for a well
pods.needsYou: a new pod, a glinting pod, pods waiting for a well, a pod that could grow or one waiting to be read is the most pressing notice

incubator.waiting: the hatched mibi's painting is on its way

crateIn.when: the Companion docks with crates while Home shows, or Home is landed on from Idle by Dock; docked on another screen, the crates are in the bay when Home next shows

steps.do: the knob settles from its lift; the ring goes
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to Idle

events.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false): every event is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end on the frame of the key (rest lands on Idle at once; the crates stand in the bay)

focus.room: the ring on nothing: no ring is drawn, ✓ does what needs the player (strings.needs), the room's point is roomAt's centre (512, 300)

primitives.spec: lvgl-switch.md §2.6.1: the edge forms, the order of a move and the integer scores on doubled centres govern; the lines below say the same in words
primitives.order: ▲ and ▼ step through the list as written, skipping ids that are not present; the ends stop, never a wrap; ◀ and ▶ take the group's own edges
primitives.nearestIn: the present target of that group with the least 400 × across + abs(along) on doubled centres: the row nearest the ring for ◀ ▶, the column nearest for ▲ ▼
primitives.nearestIn ahead: only the group's present targets more than 6 px ahead in the key's direction (along > 12 on doubled centres), least 5 × along + 11 × across
primitives.list: an ordered list: the first entry that yields a present target wins; "none" last means the ring stays

focus.held: while events.rest holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x> (kept by the host and dispatched when the hold ends)

vivarium.liftNote: the living window never moves: the ring alone marks it

resident.box: the resident's box where the face has stepped it; each sleeper is one (regions.bed.sleepers), with no lift

knob.boxNote: the knob's target box as the restKnob build registers it, at rest; with the 2 px lift it is (620, 538, 40, 16) and its round ring is regions.knob.states.focused.ring (616, 534, 48, 24), 4 px clear of the bottom line's rule at 562

layout.note: the residents the vectors are played on: three at home and two sleepers on the bed (15a)

keys.confirm: the bottom line's action for the focus (strings.actions); on the room, what needs the player (strings.needs)
keys.back: nothing: Home is the top of the tree; no ← cap, no message plate
keys.home: the ring back on the room (roomKey)
keys.vivarium: the Vivarium's whole, the ring on the mibi last seen up close
keys.research: Pods, the collection, the ring on the pod that most needs the player
keys.library: the Library's spread, the ring on the frame it was last on
keys.dock: the Caddy's Dock, a world event: the Companion returns in the top bar, the crates slide into the Cargo module (events.crateIn), the bed fills with the carried set and the notice names the crates. No message plate. Dock again lifts the Companion: the bay shuts (a cut), the bed shows the Companion mark

line.rule: the bottom line for each focus: the action (✓ and its verb), the context (mist, at most six words, the only part that may end in …), the notice (the most pressing need, strings.needs, amber with its lamp, the same wherever the ring is) and no way back

room.action: strings.needs[*].action, or no ✓ cap when nothing needs the player

vivarium.rule: {count} spelled, two to six; seven and more: many

cargo.waitingOne: a pod waits for a well

needs.rule: the notice and the room's ✓, the first that holds: the module it lights, the notice, the action. Counts are spelled (a, two to six); above what the picture holds the count is dropped

crates.noticeOne: a crate waits in the bay
crates.rule: the crates ready to open: walk crates while docked, and ready sitting crates, docked or away; the count is both, so the Cargo lamp, the notice and the room's ✓ agree: need() counts readyCrates (the ready sitting crates) with the bay's walk crates

waitingPods.noticeOne: a pod waits for a well

couldGrow.rule: short of what growing it costs, it stays a need: the short notice, ⚡ as its 16 px icon after the words, no figure

toRead.rule: short of what reading its next chapter costs, it stays a need: the short notice, ◆ as its 16 px icon after the words, no figure

placeholders.look: A PH plate is a `stone` fill with a 1 px `mist` edge inside the rect. A PH hollow is a 1 px `stone` edge with no fill. No text, shape or shading. Each id is in the register with status placeholder.

mibi.show: the register `mibi` placeholder, standing, unmirrored: a resident at its box size (144×152 or 104×112), a sleeper fitted inside 96×88, centred on footX and bottom-aligned at y 512

home-bed-192x56.show: a PH plate at [448,472,192,56] in every bed state

home-bed-mark-16x24.show: registered, nothing drawn until the art director's hand-drawn mark lands (frame-companion-outline-16x24 is a painted crop and is never drawn here)

home-crate-48x40.show: a PH plate at each walk crate's rect in the bay; they slide in with events.crateIn, clipped to the bay

home-rack-pod-24x32.show: a PH plate at well + (4,0) for each occupied well, in rack order; nothing for an empty well; the 32×40 well pod is never scaled down

home-leaf-8x12.show: a full leaf a PH plate, an empty leaf a PH hollow, at leaves.place, only while a bud is in the chamber

home-shield-12x24.show: docked: a whole plate is a PH plate, a lost plate a PH hollow; 3 on tier 1, 4 on tier 2; nothing when away

home-sitting-24x32.show: a PH plate at (912,408) while a sitting is held

placeholders.empty: the bay (open or shut), the wells, the chamber, the cradle, the journal, the nap poses and the glass master: nothing drawn, layout unchanged; the lamp, the notice, the top bar and the context line carry that information
